requirements.statement: Make one-click activation fast and uniform for all seven supported agents by separating atomic local configuration from asynchronous real-model observation and by safely handling applications that must reload settings.
acceptance: All seven targets share one completion rule: exact account model/group eligibility, native secure credential storage, atomic owned-field commit and semantic readback, required helper-owned loopback readiness, and applicable open dispatch. The activation button never sends or waits for a paid upstream model prompt.

If Claude Desktop or Codex Desktop is already running, the first request returns application_running without account, key or file mutation. After an explicit save-work confirmation, native code requests normal quit, never force termination, stops if the app remains open, and reopens the exact discovered installation after success.

Claude Code, Pi, Hermes and OpenClaw never terminate an existing terminal or editor session and plainly state that a new session uses the new settings. DSH may reuse or restart only its assistant-owned runtime.

A successfully read-back configuration remains connected when the first real model request later reports upstream timeout, quota, model or provider failure; that observation appears in the existing recent-connection result and can guide model or line switching.

Synthetic native and renderer tests cover every adapter, running/not-running/refused desktop lifecycle branches, no-force-kill behavior, rollback/reopen behavior, truthful copy, and macOS Apple-Silicon plus Windows compilation without packaging.

requirements.statement: Enable a remotely controllable domestic mirror for exact official Codex and Claude Desktop packages without weakening client-native trust checks or blocking publication on a separate legal-evidence file.
acceptance: The operator publisher needs no vendor-permission or source-approval JSON. It accepts only an exact current private candidate fetched from one of six compiled official origins, rechecks source metadata, package structure, identity, architecture, publisher, size and SHA256, and never grants the periodic synchronizer public-root write access.

Catalog schema 2 distinguishes native_verified from client_native_required. A valid matching native receipt is the only way to emit native_verified; absent receipt emits client_native_required and never claims server-side signature verification. The public catalog contains no approval, legal-basis, operator identity, credential or private-path fields.

The client accepts only the fixed ergou.qzz.io catalog and immutable source-slot/hash URL. Both verification states still pass through the same local macOS codesign, Team ID, bundle identity and Gatekeeper checks or Windows manifest, App Installer and installed-package trust checks before completion. A catalog assertion alone is never executable trust.

An operator can atomically disable every mirrored installer by publishing a valid empty catalog and false health projection without deleting objects or requiring a client update. Re-publication re-enables individual current candidates, prevents downgrade, preserves unrelated slots and previous immutable objects, and recovers safely after catalog or health interruption.

Missing, empty, stale, malformed, unsupported, corrupt, unavailable or disabled mirror state falls back to the compiled official path with truthful source UI and no account credentials. Mirror download failure never reuses partial bytes across source, URL, version, size or digest.

The beginner UI describes the mirror as domestic acceleration and says the vendor signature is checked before installation; it does not show policy, implementation or legal-risk text and does not claim a mirrored object has already been installed or works on an untested clean machine.

Publish the verified server catalog and packages only after focused publisher, kill-switch, client parser, native trust, fallback, renderer and cross-platform compile scenarios pass. Keep Yecai packaging/version/updater channels, database, NewAPI, shared ingress, forced third-party updates and installed-app replacement outside this release unit.

requirements.statement: Complete the download-source plumbing and restore official Claude macOS package discovery without misrepresenting public publication or installation verification.
acceptance: Resolve Claude macOS currentRelease through the official public universal RELEASES.json feed and download its exact versioned ZIP; reject malformed, ambiguous, nonofficial, oversized or downgraded candidates without replacing last-good bytes. Never bypass a challenge.

Safely inspect and extract the official Claude.app ZIP in an owned private directory; validate member paths, duplicates, symlink targets, expansion limits and native vendor signature before exclusive installation. No overwrite or privilege/trust changes.

Provide a separate operator publisher that requires a SHA-bound native signature receipt plus explicit source-specific distribution approval, rehashes exact staged bytes, publishes immutable objects and atomically replaces a closed catalog while preserving unaffected last-good entries. No routine sync job gets public-root write access.

Client reads the fixed unauthenticated catalog on explicit Start; allowlisted exact source identities, immutable URLs, sizes and hashes bind package selection. A missing/unusable mirror falls back to official sources with truthful source projection; bad bytes are not installed or resumed across different artifact identities.

Preserve existing desktop installation v2 wire request/shape and consent semantics; the bundled renderer/native pair atomically add the mirror source discriminant under reviewed successor contract. No account credentials sent to a download origin.

Deploy only the scoped private sync update and verify a downloaded official Mac ZIP with native tools on this Mac without launching or replacing the installed app. Public redistribution remains unexecuted until an affirmative basis is supplied; Windows native verification and clean-machine installs remain distinct evidence gaps.

Execute focused server publication/feed/ZIP tests, native download/ZIP/manifest regression tests, renderer source/fallback scenarios and production/cross-platform compile checks. No Yecai packaging, version change, automatic update publication or broad server modifications.

requirements.statement: Make novice installation recoverable across application changes and logged-out system confirmation; remove false existing-app detection and verify the current full workbench instead of obsolete legacy screens.
acceptance: An ordinary ChatGPT bundle must not suppress Codex installation. Reuse canonical application identity; an unrelated existing destination must produce an actionable conflict, never installed and never overwrite.

After a global installer job finishes for another selected app, load the selected app plan without repeating mutations or polling ping-pong. Explicit recheck refreshes installer state and discovery; navigation or account/model changes cannot resurrect auto-activation consent.

Windows users can confirm installation without logging in or selecting a model. Checking alone creates no connection intent and never writes credentials; signed-in automatic continuation retains the exact one-use native session and full-selection proof.

Replace seven obsolete legacy App screen assertions with current workbench integration journeys at the native boundary, preserving independent provider/hook/component regressions. Execute all repository Vitest tests and inherited native/cross-platform/build acceptance on the final source state, not merely src tests.

Exercise retry, unavailable progress, unfinished Windows installation, existing destination preservation, logged-out completion and changed selection. Use clear user actions instead of terminal instructions or false completion.

No packaging, release, public binary distribution, server modifications, admin policy changes or overwrite of an installed app. Existing download-origin checks and cross-compilation cannot establish mainland download usability or Windows/Apple-Silicon clean-machine acceptance; report the remaining evidence separately.

requirements.statement: Provide novice install-and-connect with native Mac installation, explicit Windows system installation confirmation, guided other clients, and exact one-use session-bound connection handoff.
acceptance: Missing desktop apps offer installation without architecture/path/command choices; existing applications retain ordinary connect/open/restore. Other clients clearly offer official installation guidance.

Only compiled original HTTPS sources and package identities are accepted. Exact redirect, size/type, owned-file and cache validator checks precede native trust. No arbitrary URL/path/command, account credentials, public mirror publication or forced update.

Mac verifies codesign/Team/bundle/Gatekeeper, stages privately, and publishes exclusively without replacement. Windows checks manifest identity/publisher/architecture, opens the hash-bound local package in system App Installer, explicitly leaves trust pending, and never silently deploys. Tell users to cancel Reinstall/Replace; OS installation choices remain user-owned.

Single request-idempotent native job; safe download cancellation and validator-bound resume, same-package hash reuse and recoverable progress across navigation. Bad metadata, signatures, partial bodies, races, ambiguous targets and lost responses cannot claim completion.

Mac automatic continuation and explicitly confirmed Windows continuation use an exact job-associated native target and one-use full model/group/default/line intent bound to the native session epoch. Renderer selection/navigation revisions invalidate A-to-B-to-A continuations. Fresh native/account/model validation remains mandatory.

Mac mutation drains under existing shutdown admission, including worker errors and cleanup. Windows releases admission after safe system-UI handoff; Yecai cancellation/exit does not cancel Windows installation. A failed connection leaves the installed app in place and uses existing settings recovery.

Use accessible progress and actionable source/network/space/trust/dependency/permission recovery, not engineering jargon. Fixture/cross-compilation results are distinct from clean-machine native installation. No package/release/server mutation in this implementation unit.

Existing workbench/repair tests must explicitly accept only read-only installer inspection on passive navigation. Missing-app count tests now require two visible desktop installation choices. Retain all prior test selectors and forbid start/confirm/help calls without user action.

requirements.statement: Provide novice install-and-connect with native Mac installation, explicit Windows system installation confirmation, guided other clients, and exact one-use session-bound connection handoff.
acceptance: Missing desktop apps offer installation without architecture/path/command choices; existing applications retain ordinary connect/open/restore. Other clients clearly offer official installation guidance.

Only compiled original HTTPS sources and package identities are accepted. Exact redirect, size/type, owned-file and cache validator checks precede native trust. No arbitrary URL/path/command, account credentials, public mirror publication or forced update.

Mac verifies codesign/Team/bundle/Gatekeeper, stages privately, and publishes exclusively without replacement. Windows checks manifest identity/publisher/architecture, opens the hash-bound local package in system App Installer, explicitly leaves trust pending, and never silently deploys. Tell users to cancel Reinstall/Replace; OS installation choices remain user-owned.

Single request-idempotent native job; safe download cancellation and validator-bound resume, same-package hash reuse and recoverable progress across navigation. Bad metadata, signatures, partial bodies, races, ambiguous targets and lost responses cannot claim completion.

Mac automatic continuation and explicitly confirmed Windows continuation use an exact job-associated native target and one-use full model/group/default/line intent bound to the native session epoch. Renderer selection/navigation revisions invalidate A-to-B-to-A continuations. Fresh native/account/model validation remains mandatory.

A failed connection leaves the installed app in place and uses existing settings recovery.
